name: IAXO
notes: BabyIAXO has its own INSPIRE experiment record (recid 1826394, 'BabyIAXO: An intermediate experimental stage of the International Axion Observatory'); modelled here as an interval on the single experiment:iaxo record rather than a second experiment id, since the collaboration's own sources treat it as a stage of one program.

physics_goals.quote: The International Axion Observatory (IAXO) is a proposed fourth-generation axion helioscope.
physics_goals.value: Search for solar axions with a purpose-built helioscope with much larger sensitivity than CAST

summary.plain: IAXO is a planned next-generation axion helioscope at DESY, a much larger successor to CAST. Its intermediate prototype, BabyIAXO, is currently under construction, while the full-scale instrument remains a proposal.
summary.technical: Fourth-generation axion helioscope program: full-scale IAXO (proposed 2013, not yet approved/built) and its intermediate prototype BabyIAXO (INSPIRE recid 1826394), currently under construction at DESY as of the 2025 European Strategy input document.
